# personal-power-system — agent guidance

This is a hardware documentation project with no application code. All agent guidance lives in [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md), which applies to Copilot and any other AI agent working here.

Key points:

- `specs/001-battery-box/as-built.md` and `specs/001-battery-box/verification-and-safety.md` are the only authoritative descriptions of the current hardware and its verification state. Other spec files are historical design documents.
- Every hardware claim carries an evidence tag. Never record a test as passed or a component as compliant without a dated record.
- Documentation-only changes unless explicitly authorized. No hardware design decisions, fuse sizing, or component selection.
- Plan first, get approval, then change the repository.

The SpecKit agent definitions and prompts in this directory and `.github/prompts/` are retained from the original methodology and are not the active workflow.
